briefdescription.para: Case entity for the clinics_requests table (a visit's requests).

detaileddescription.para: This header declares the Requests class, a small C++ type that stands for the requests record of one visit in the clinics_requests database table. There is at most one such record per visit because the visit id is the table's primary key. The class itself holds no data; it names the table and leaves SQL generation to its parent Case. It also supplies small helper functions that build permission-checking SQL for create, read, update and delete operations.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: Requests is one of the clinic-owned "case" types exposed through the clinic routes as ClinicController<Requests> under the requests service type. When a client wants to add or change a visit's requests, PermissionManager calls the static getPermissionsQueryFor* helpers here to build a SELECT that finds which clinic owns the visit (via clinics_visits), then checks whether the requesting user is that clinic's owner, admin or staff. Without this file there would be no C++ type connecting the clinics_requests table to the CRUD and permission machinery, so requests endpoints could not work.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
static constexpr: a value fixed at compile time that belongs to the class, not to one object. https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/static
JSON: a text format used to carry request data; this project uses the jsoncons library to read it. https://jsoncons.github.io/jsoncons/
Foreign key / ON DELETE CASCADE: a column that points to a row in another table, with the database automatically deleting this row when that parent row is deleted. https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp
